headline: Putin asegura que responderá con dureza tras nuevo ataque de Ucrania contra el puente de Crimea
summary: Russian President Vladimir Putin said Moscow would respond harshly after Ukraine attacked the bridge linking Russia with Crimea for the third time this week. No damage details were given in the input.
why: The Crimea bridge is a key transport link for Russia and affects logistics and military supply routes in the Black Sea region. Escalation between Russia and Ukraine affects energy, grain and commodity risk premiums.
